name: Dumbbell Spider Curl
steps: Lie chest-down on a moderately inclined bench with your feet planted behind you and a dumbbell in each hand.
Let both arms hang straight down vertically from your shoulders with your palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders while keeping your upper arms stationary and perpendicular to the floor.
Pause briefly to squeeze your biceps at the top, then lower the weights slowly back to full arm extension.
tips: Keep your chest pressed against the bench so you do not use your lower back to swing the dumbbells.
Avoid pulling your elbows backward as you curl upward.
